key_insight: This manuscript was withdrawn, so it does not provide a reliable validated insight for predicting endometrial cancer risk using TyGFI in U.S. women aged 45+.
clinical_relevance: Because the analysis was deemed statistically flawed, it should not be used to guide research conclusions or clinical interpretation.
method: NHANES 2011–2018 data from U.S. women aged 45+
Combined triglyceride-glucose (TyG) and frailty index into TyGFI
Applied logistic modeling and machine-learning workflows
evidence_signal: The abstract states that the number of positive cases was too small, creating major statistical flaws and making the findings unreliable.
watch_item: Do not cite or implement the reported associations without a fully powered reanalysis and independent validation.
paper_title: WITHDRAWN: Combined triglyceride-glucose and frailty index (TyGFI) and risk of endometrial cancer in U.S. women aged >=45: NHANES 2011-2018 analysis integrating data engineering and machine learning with logistic modeling
